name: You Never Left
source:
Laven would rather sit down with a good book than socialize with others. One day, she is pushed out of her comfort zone and asked by the high school playboy to help tutor him. Will you lead her to help him? Or will you lead her to turn him down and stay in her comfort zone?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31437]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
拉文宁愿坐下来读一本好书，也不愿与他人交往。有一天，她被推出了自己的舒适区，并被一名高中花花公子请求帮助辅导他。你会带领她去帮助他吗？或者你会引导她拒绝他并留在她的舒适区吗？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31437]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
